notes: The schematic image was not available; connections are inferred from the text and the standard single-MOSFET 3.3V-to-5V translator: MKR pin 6 -> 2N7000 gate, source -> GND, drain -> NeoPixel DIN with the 10k resistor pulling the drain up to 5V. This inverts the signal; the exact topology and the data pin (6) are assumptions.

The manual says the layout uses a single NeoPixel in place of the ring, so a catalogue 'neopixel' is used. The catalogue lists no ports for it, so DIN, 5V and GND were chosen. The 24-LED ring would connect the same way.
5V for the NeoPixel and pull-up is taken from the MKR GSM 1400 5V pin (USB-powered). Breadboard positions are arbitrary but electrically consistent.

Antenna, SIM card, LiPo battery, USB cable and PC are included from the setup steps. The catalogue usb-cable and laptop entries have specific or no ports, so the cable edges use a null port on the cable side.
MKR GSM 1400 and 2N7000 are not in the catalogue; ports were limited to those used. Port S/G/D pin order of the 2N7000 (TO-92) is assumed.
